programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Meri Haan Teri Naa
programme.desc: Childhood friends Ashok and Julie are very close and believe friendship is above love. However, when Julie's father dies, Ashok and his wife bring her to their house and try to find a groom for her.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Trip
programme.desc: A group of friends travel through a dense forest and encounter two men, who they mistake for killers. The longer they stay in the woods, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel
programme.desc: A young girl loses her parents in an accident due to illegal bike racers in Chennai. She soon sets out to exact revenge on the racer responsible for her parents' death.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game in 'Mega Bounce Battle', then in 'Gossip Guy', the school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears. (S4, ep 18)

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: Rock, Paper, and Scissors go birdwatching in 'The Watching', then in 'Nightmares', the guys are trapped in a nightmare. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car in 'Emotional Support Convertible', then in 'The Baseball', the trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Halmoni trains Jack & Lil in Trot dance in 'The Meatball of Canyon Valley', then in 'Sticky Fingers', Jack fumbles a simple errand for Min. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Will must fix the air conditioning during a crazy heat wave in 'Where There's a Will, There's a Way', then in 'Lost in the Sauce', Ellie obsesses over a conspiracy. (S1, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Pirates show up at the house in 'Pirates Life', then in 'World Record', The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game. (S4, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor in 'Allergic Reaction', then in 'Lice-enced to Teach', Dave sets up a classroom in the house, and becomes the teacher. (S4, ep 16)

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: Pyg & Tam: A cute Baby TV show threatens Boss Baby, who tries to spark a conflict. (S2, ep 13)

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: Conference Room B: Boss Baby promises to help Tim with their parents' anniversary gift but sends Hendershot instead after Puppy Co. and Baby Corp clash. Hendershot tries to keep Tim happy. (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Summer of Secrets: Chloe must attend summer school, and Max is assigned to be her teacher. While they will be busy all summer, Phoebe goes solo with a new superhero named Captain Perfect. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: I Know What You Did This Summer: Max learns that Phoebe is working with Captain Perfect, and sets out to uncover the secret he is keeping. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Kid Grounded: When Henry is caught sneaking out at night, he is grounded, keeping him from his crime-fighting duties. Piper drives him crazy at home. Charlotte becomes sidekick. (S1, ep 21)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court in 'Witless of the Prosecution', then in 'Time for the News', Perch travels through time to cover historical events. (S5, ep 8)

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Squidward and SpongeBob become a comedy duo in 'The Squid and the Square', then in 'The Over-Under', Cecil and Patrick sell underwear. (S5, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin almost drives a local toy store out of business in 'Unboxing Day', then in 'Dave's Pavillion', Dave's new pavilion is surprisingly ruined for some reason. But who is to blame? (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin pretends to write a broadway show in 'Writer's Blocked', and in 'Jinxed!', after Theodore sees Alvin accidentally ruin Dave's computer, Alvin jinxes Theodore so he can't tell on him. (S5, ep 11)

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: Rock, Paper, and Scissors meet Henry Winkler in 'The Henry Winkler Episode', then in 'Paper Loves Potato', Paper starts dating Potato. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: Rock struggles to keep a secret from Paper in 'The Secret', then in 'Sandpaper's Workout Program', Sandpaper makes the guys work out. (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: Six Well-Placed Kittens: When Bootsy's plan of 6 strategically placed kittens brings the whole town down, Mega Fat is forced to team with Boss Baby. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: As the Diaper Changes: When Grandma Templeton comes to stay, Boss Baby and Tim struggle to be roommates. Meanwhile, Baby Corp's new CEO trusts Boss Baby with the new Stinkless Serum. (S1, ep 14)

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Cruel Summer: Max and Phoebe are working well as a team, until he is accused of committing crimes and Phoebe must apprehend him. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Endless Summer: Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil. (S2, ,ep 7)

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: Unlucky leprechaun Happy McSweeney is in for the adventure of a lifetime when he and his friends set out on a daring mission to retrieve the pot of gold that was stolen from them years ago.

programme.title: Blurt
programme.desc: When a kid puts on a mysterious set of VR glasses, he has to say everything he thinks out loud, and finds that sometimes you have to speak up to make a difference. Starring Jace Norman and Jojo Siwa.

programme.title: Nickelodeon Slimetime UK
programme.desc: Slimetime UK is back! Watch for the latest on American Football, with special guests and a bit of slime mixed in. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Munk Vs Machine: The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete in a dodgeball tournament but no-one expects Theo to be their secret weapon. (S4, ep 9a)

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Salmon Cat: Sam & Cat must rename their babysitting business, because it's too similar to a TV show from the 1970s. They track down the show's creators and resolve a long feud. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: My Poober: Sam and Cat are charged with getting a babysitting client to give up her "Poober" - her ratty old stuffed animal. This proves more difficult than it first appears. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay
programme.desc: Lay Lay's Line Line Dance Dance: Lay Lay mocks Sadie's interest in a country music dance contest but, feels neglected when Sadie goes to the competition without her. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay
programme.desc: Dylan and Rebecca's Cleve-Land-Land Adventure: The Alexanders get another visit from Young Dylan, whose cousin Rebecca joins Sadie at the launch event for a new video game; (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: The Thundermans

programme.title: Henry Danger

programme.title: Henry Danger

programme.title: Jimmy Somerville: Smalltown Boy

programme.title: Jail Bait (1954)

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Night On The Town. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Ransom. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Robert Raglan & Philip Ashley. Robin Hood comes to the aid of heavily taxed villagers who are being forced to raise the ransom for the Count of Severne's son.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Hostage. 1961. Stars George Murcell & David Graham. While in Ireland, Dr. Beaker overhears a plan by two smugglers to kidnap the daughter of an innkeeper and alerts his friends back at base.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Price of Vanity. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Christopher Lee & Eric Lander. A young artist has the key to a successful career, he can fake old masters well enough to deceive an art critic.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: House Call. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Hollow Triumph
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Steve Sekely. Stars Paul Henreid, Joan Bennett, Leslie Brooks & Eduard Franz. Pursued by the gambler he robbed, John Muller takes on a new identity, with ironic results.

programme.title: The Delavine Affair
programme.desc: 1955. Crime drama starring Peter Reynolds, Honor Blackman and Gordon Jackson. The death of a local man leads a local reporter to seek his killer.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: With All My Heart
programme.desc: 1955. Stars Ida Lupino, Walter Coy & Noreen Nash. A schoolteacher's miserable love life improves after a childhood sweetheart brings out her inner beauty.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Ritual. 1975. Stars Douglas Fielding, Susan Jameson, John Nettleton. Skinner has been shot dead, and the Murder Squad have taken over the case. So why is Haggar meeting a mate halfway down the M6?

programme.title: And The Same To You
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy starring Sid James, Brian Rix, Leo Franklyn, Tommy Cooper and Vera Day. The boxing-mad nephew of a pious clergyman embarks on an elaborate plan to keep his boxing career a secret.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: A year and a Day. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory & Derrick Sherwin. A desperate man steals Richard's horse and the squire of Fitzgeorge castle takes him in.

programme.title: Sleeping Car To Trieste
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Director: John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Jean Kent, Bonar Colleano, Albert Lieven & David Tomlinson. Agents break into an embassy in Paris to steal a diary filled with political secrets.

programme.title: Dangerous Cargo
programme.desc: 1954. Drama directed by John Harlow. Tim (Jack Watling) is tricked by a wartime friend (Terence Alexander) into revealing details of a gold shipment.

programme.title: Brighton Rock
programme.desc: 1947. Crime. Directed by John Boulting. Stars Richard Attenborough & Hermione Baddeley. Small time gang leader, Pinkie Brown, desperately tries to cover his tracks after he murders a journalist.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. Personal and Confidential. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Ellen McIntosh. Police investigating a suspicious death find a file marked 'Top Secret' in the victim's briefcase. (S1, E07)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week, enjoy a reel on leaving school and finding a job in 1950s Yorkshire! Jean Muir is here to persuade you to part with your shillings, Tufty has some sound advice and visit 1950s Slough!

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret and the Liberty Bar. 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Pascale Roberts & Marina Golovine. Maigret is sent to Antibes to investigate the murder of an Australian who'd been with French intelligence.

programme.title: Bullshot
programme.desc: 1983. Comedy. Directed by Dick Clement. Stars Alan Shearman, Diz White & Ronald E. House. Dashing Captain, Hugh 'Bullshot' Crummond, must put his talents to the test and save the world.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1960. Evidence in Concrete. Directed by Gordon Hales. Starring Russell Napier, Howard Pays and Peter Welch. A young girl's body found near a busy motorway tells of something sinister. (S1, E34)

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Avignon - Meurtres à Avignon. 2015. Director: Stéphane Kappes. Stars Catherine Jacob & Laëtitia Milot. Police investigate a skeleton found in a secret chamber in the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Marie Walters Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert Karnes & Barbara Stuart. Detective Ruditsky solves the murder of a young woman by uncovering crucial evidence.

programme.title: The First Travelling Saleslady
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy Western. A corset store owner goes broke and becomes a traveling sales lady in Texas 1897. Starring Ginger Rogers, Barry Nelson and a young Clint Eastwood.

programme.title: A Celebration of Nettlefold Studios and Cecil Hepworth
programme.desc: Join Dr Simon Brown, Mike Read, William Russell and Patricia Dainton to celebrate the famous Nettlefold Studios. We explore the history of Nettlefold.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hot Off the Griddle. 1966. Stars Adam West & Julie Newmar. The thefts of a department store catalogue, a catamaran, and three mittens, alerts Batman and Robin that Catwoman is loose again.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Cat and the Fiddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Julie Newmar & Jack Kelly. Batman and Robin discover Catwoman is now masquerading as rich old Minerva Matthews and must stop her next scheme.

programme.title: A Taste Of Money
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Jean Cadell, Dick Emery and Pete Murray. An elderly spinster plots to rob her employers with the perfect crime!

programme.title: House of Blackmail
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Directed by Maurice Elvey. An Army officer (William Sylvester) and Carol (Mary Germaine) must solve the murder of a blackmailer or be charged themselves.

programme.title: Susan Lenox: Her Rise and Fall
programme.desc: 1931. Drama. Directed by Robert Z. Leonard. Stars Greta Garbo & Clark Gable. A young girl who escapes from home to find a new life, falls in love with a kind stranger, but fate keeps them apart.

programme.title: Mad Mel and Mister Gibson
programme.desc: 2021. The rise, fall and resurrection of Mel Gibson, one of the most successful but also controversial Hollywood stars. From Mad Max to The Passion of the Christ, from Lethal Weapon to Braveheart.

programme.title: Stranger In Town
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed George Pollock. Starring Alex Nicol, Anne Paige & Mary Laura Wood. In a sleepy village, a composer is shot dead and a woman is found gassed. Who killed them and why?

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Master Spy. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips, Adrienne Corri & Jack Watling. A beautiful but dangerous spy, known as The Shadow, is sent by Gessler to lure Tell and his followers into a trap.

programme.title: The Love Match
programme.desc: Comedy. Director: David Paltenghi. Stars Arthur Askey, Glenn Melvyn & Thora Hird. Two football loving railway workers get into trouble after racing their engine home to get to a match on time.

programme.title: The Sea Shall Not Have Them
programme.desc: 1954. War. Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Stars Michael Redgrave, Dirk Bogarde & Bonar Colleano. In 1944, passengers of a downed aircraft discuss their lives while awaiting rescue from the North Sea.

programme.title: Mr Denning Drives North
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Anthony Kimmins. Stars John Mills, Phyllis Calvert & Eileen Moore. A British aircraft engineer accidentally kills his daughter's boyfriend and then tries to it cover up...

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Deadly Goddess Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Michael Strong. Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal significant funds from THRUSH.

programme.title: Tales of Manhattan
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Julien Duvivier. Stars Charles Boyer, Rita Hayworth, Henry Fonda. An anthology of five stories revolving around a cursed tailcoat that brings misfortune to all who wear it.

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: The Rough and the Smooth
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Starring Nadja Tiller, Tony Britton and William Bendix. Directed by Robert Siodmak. An archaeologist forsakes his fiancée for a passionate affair with a beautiful German woman.

programme.title: The Party's Over
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Directed by Guy Hamilton. A controversial film of its time. A young American girl is caught up in the wild London scene. Starring Oliver Reed.

programme.title: A Trip into Wharfedale
programme.desc: A charming amateur film on a day trip in the 40s around the Yorkshire dales. Wonderful shots of vintage transport and hotels in the area and high streets.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: William Wyler is the film director that brought Mrs Miniver and Roman Holiday with Audrey Hepburn. His actors won more Oscars than for any other director.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Minstrel's Shakedown. 1966. Stars Adam West, Van Johnson & Leslie Perkins. A new villain called The Minstrel throws the Gotham Stock Exchange into chaos, sending the market into near disaster.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Barbecued Batman? 1966. Stars Adam West, Van Johnson & Remo Pisani. Batman and Robin place a bugging device in Amanda's purse and discover The Minstrel's wicked plan. Can they stop him in time?

programme.title: Fate Takes a Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Ronald Howard, Christina Gregg, Basil Dignam. Letters recovered from a stolen mail bag significantly impact the lives of the recipients 15 years later.

programme.title: Pleasure Hunt 1956
programme.desc: 1956. A previously lost Hammer short about a young man who takes a girl on a day out, where they visit Battersea Funfair in London before going to the Farnborough Air Show.

programme.title: The Dark Road
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Alfred J. Goulding. Stars Farnham Baxter, Cyril Chamberlain & Sydney Bromley. The story of Sidney Robertson and his rise from a petty thief to an underworld crime boss.

programme.title: Highly Dangerous
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Roy Ward Baker. Stars: Margaret Lockwood, Dane Clark, Marius Goring. An entomologist travels to a Balkan country to investigate germ warfare.

programme.title: The Son of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: 1940. Action. Director: Rowland V. Lee. Louis Hayward, George Sanders, Joan Bennett. Rightful owner of the kingdom, the Duchess of Zona, is engaged in a power struggle with the evil General Gurko.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: To the Rescue. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Ewen Solon & Andre Charisse. Tempest arrives in Savannah with the promise of valuable cargo but winds up attempting to smuggle a tobacco crop out.

programme.title: Le Poulet
programme.desc: Le Poulet (The Chicken). 1965. A child becomes attached to a chicken. To stop his parents from eating it, he places an egg near the animal every morning, making it seem like a hen.

programme.title: My Cousin Rachel (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Directed by Henry Koster. Stars Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton & Audrey Dalton. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is a murderess.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Charles Laughton, John Mills & Brenda de Banzie. Henry Hobson's three daughters want to marry, but he refuses as traditions require him to pay settlements.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt1. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. Two people who are widely separated by personality and character are brought together by just one factor...

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt2. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. After listening to Muriel's story, it is now Sally's turn to tell hers.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Trammel Nets/Coach Builder. 1986. Two more excerpts from Jack Hargreaves's archive as he goes inshore fishing with a three-tiered net and visits a factory that makes wooden cart wheels.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Whipping Boy. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. The rivalry between the Captain & the Colonel rears up again, leaving Spiker demoted and Moat imposing terror.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Rich Man, Poor Man. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. An explosion almost kills a worker at a factory, and a poor immigrant barber is beaten to death in a luxury apartment.

programme.title: Modesty Blaise
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Joseph Losey. Stars Monica Vitti, Dirk Bogarde & Terrence Stamp. A spy spoof in the 60s tradition with comic book heroine, Modesty Blaise. Set in the Italian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: Meet Mr Callaghan

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: A Barrel Full Of Moneys. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Swindler. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Spell of Tut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Victor Buono & Marianna Hill. Batman and Robin battle the nefarious King Tut who plots to take over Gotham City with an ancient potion.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Tut's Case is Shut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Marianna Hill, Sid Haig. Robin reveals that Gordon's secretary, Miss Cleo Patrick, is working for Tut and plans to slip the Commissioner a scarab mickey.

programme.title: The Rossiter Case

programme.title: Confession

programme.title: Three Sundays to Live

programme.title: Men In War

programme.title: Scotland Yard

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street

programme.title: Look At Life High, Wide and Faster

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season

programme.title: Scrooge

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season

programme.title: The Brothers

programme.title: Mark Saber

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 24. 1975. Gene Pitney performs 'Half Heaven Half Heartache' and 'Blue Angel'. Plus, there's performances from Paul Daniels, Royal Polynesian Revue and Rivendell.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's Melissa

programme.title: The Velvet Touch

programme.title: Star Performance: The Hard Way

programme.title: Sergeant Cork

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed The Toy Soldier? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. A horrible boss in charge of a toy firm is murdered.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Greatest Mother of Them All. 1966. Stars Adam West, Shelley Winters & Tisha Sterling. The infamous Ma Parker and her fiendish children raid Gotham's Ladies Auxiliary's Mother of the Year Awards.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Ma Parker. 1966. Stars Adam West & Shelley Winters. After finding a bomb in the Batmobile, Batman and Robin rush back to the prison to check on The Parkers, but all seems suspiciously well.

programme.title: East of Sudan
programme.desc: 1964. Adventure. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Sims & Derek Fowlds. Two colonial soldiers in 19th-century Africa risk their lives to save a governess and her charge.

programme.title: Tufty Club: Always Hold Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: A delightful short animation for children about remembering to hold mummy's hand when out and about.

programme.title: The Black Rider

programme.title: UK TV Premiere- Tu Meri Main Tera Tu Meri
programme.desc: Two souls discover each other and fall deeply in love, but family pressures force them apart. They part with heavy hearts, holding on to the hope of meeting again someday.

programme.title: O'Romeo
programme.desc: A skilled enforcer helps a woman seek justice for her husband's death. As danger grows and enemies close in, their bond deepens amid betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd.
programme.desc: Six newlywed couples on their honeymoon in Goa uncover secrets and hidden sides of their spouses during a four-day journey that changes their relationships.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: 2.0 Robot
programme.desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

programme.title: Vijaypath
programme.desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

programme.title: De De Pyaar De 2
programme.desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

programme.title: Sooryavanshi
programme.desc: With Mumbai under threat of a major terrorist attack, ATS chief Sooryavanshi launches a high-stakes mission to track down 600 kg of missing RDX and the masterminds behind the plot.

programme.title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
programme.desc: (Movies @6) Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl who is speech-impaired lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she is from Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great cost.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Stripped of their honor, disgraced former army officers answer Colonel Puri's plea for redemption by standing together to defend an innocent village against the sadistic bandit Jageera.

programme.title: Annapoorani: The Goddess Of Food
programme.desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

programme.title: Table No. 21
programme.desc: Vivaan and Siya, stuck in a monotonous marriage, enter a game show hoping to revive excitement with a big prize, but the challenge soon turns into a deadly struggle for survival.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Ram Lakhan
